# dns_soa_record (Resource)

Manages a SOA DNS record. This resource does not create or delete the SOA record as it always exists for a zone. It only reads and updates the SOA record fields.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dns_soa_record" "example" {
  zone    = "example.com."
  mname   = "ns1.example.com."
  rname   = "admin.example.com."
  refresh = 3600
  retry   = 1800
  expire  = 86400
  ttl     = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expire` (Number) The expire time in seconds.
- `mname` (String) The primary master name for the zone.
- `refresh` (Number) The refresh interval in seconds.
- `retry` (Number) The retry interval in seconds.
- `rname` (String) The email address of the administrator responsible for the zone.
- `zone` (String) DNS zone the record belongs to. It must be an FQDN, that is, include the trailing dot.

### Optional

- `ttl` (Number) The TTL of the record. Defaults to `3600`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always set to the zone.
